The spy is cold, accusatory, and tries to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role in the doll’s mischief. The narrator’s note that he looks like one of the hags but “smells of blood and moss” hints that his disguise is imperfect. The player has arrived either to investigate or to help Mayrina and is being watched and questioned by this suspicious spy.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_MaskedVictim_02.json: The player is speaking to a terrified survivor holed up in the Blushing Mermaid cellar while wearing a hag mask, so the victim mistakes the player for the hag “Auntie.” Off-screen, this cellar is where a small support group of hag survivors has gathered to research and comfort one another; one member of that group is secretly a redcap spy (Jatlo) who has been tormenting them with a cursed doll or hexing Mayrina. The masked victim is traumatized and prone to panicked, reverent responses about the hag—talking about old bullies, watching Auntie hurt them, and calling out desperately for her. Depending on other events, Mayrina may be present and cursed (or already cured), and the redcap’s deception may or may not have been exposed to the group.

The survivors are a traumatised support/research group; a redcap spy (Jatlo) has been secretly tormenting them — if Mayrina is present she may have been hexed into a sheep, and if she isn’t a bewitched doll has been frightening the group. The masked victim’s lines are tearful and dreamy, calling the hag “Auntie” and praising her, which signals lingering fear and enchantment rather than lucidity. These samples show the default responses to a hag-like presence; other dialogue branches handle curing Mayrina, exposing the spy, or killing the hag.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_MaskedVictim_03.json: The scene is in the Blushing Mermaid cellar where a small support group of hag survivors has been living and researching hags; one of those survivors (the “masked victim”) is clearly traumatized and speaks in a dreamy, panicked voice about a crying baby and an “Auntie.” When the player is wearing a hag mask, the victim’s lines shift into eerie, childlike or frantic ramblings as if addressing or pleading with a hag figure — sometimes calm/delusional, sometimes frantic and demanding. context: Mayrina is a member of a small Lower City hag‑survivors group who has been hexed into a sheep by a bewitched voodoo doll secretly planted by a redcap spy (Jatlo) sent by a hag. Though physically a sheep, she clearly retains her human mind — human eyes, desperate attempts to speak, and frantic attempts to name the doll — but a curse prevents her from saying the doll’s name. The player has come into the survivors’ shelter (the Blushing Mermaid cellar) to examine and help her, using commands and investigation to learn what happened and break the hex. The group is tense and fearful; the spy may still be disguised among them and will try to deflect blame or turn hostile if exposed.
